Title: PRACTICANTE
Description: En FEMSA generamos valor económico y social y buscamos ser el mejor empleador y vecino. A través de nuestras Divisiones de Proximidad, Salud y Digital y Unidades de Negocio Coca-Cola FEMSA y FEMSA Negocios Estratégicos, empleamos a más de 354 mil personas en los países donde tenemos presencia. Proposito Del Rol Apoyar en la gestión, análisis y mejora de los sistemas de información utilizados en la operación y expansión de tiendas a nivel nacional, contribuyendo en la generación de indicadores, administración de plataformas y soporte a proyectos de innovación y mejora continua. Principales Responsabilidades Apoyar en la extracción, consulta y análisis de información mediante bases de datos (SQL / queries). Generar y dar seguimiento a indicadores operativos relacionados con expansión, mantenimiento y desempeño de tiendas. Colaborar en la administración de plataformas (altas, bajas y cambios de usuarios y atributos). Elaborar reportes y asegurar la calidad de la información para la toma de decisiones. Participar en proyectos de mejora de procesos, herramientas y control de inversiones. Apoyar en la implementación y seguimiento de proyectos a nivel nacional. Brindar soporte a usuarios internos y comunicación con distintas regiones. Participar en reuniones de seguimiento, documentación de procesos y control de cambios Requisitos Estudiante activo de 6° o 7° semestre en: Ingeniería en Sistemas Ingeniería en Tecnologías de la Información Interés en análisis de datos, sistemas y mejora de procesos Excel intermedio – avanzado (indispensable) Conocimientos básicos de SQL (consultas a bases de datos) Deseable: Power BI o TableauHabilidades analíticas, organización y trabajo en equipo Horario Lunes a viernes 8:00am a 3:00pm Modalidad: Remoto (con disponibilidad de asistir a reuniones o juntas) En FEMSA y todos nuestros negocios, los procesos de reclutamiento y selección son gratuitos y operan con principios de respeto por el individuo, la sociedad y el medio ambiente sin hacer distinción alguna por religión, género, edad, nivel socioeconómico, origen étnico, discapacidad u otros.

Title: Data Analyst ID61986
Description: AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards. WHY JOIN US If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you! ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior/Lead Data Analyst to turn large, complex datasets into clear insights that inform decisions across the business. You will write advanced SQL queries against Snowflake, build dashboards in tools like Tableau or Power BI, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. The role is focused on analysis and visualization and actively incorporates AI copilots to accelerate query generation and data exploration. Strong data quality instincts and the ability to work independently across cross-functional teams are essential. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Write, optimize, and maintain advanced SQL queries for data extraction and analysis; - Perform deep-dive analysis on large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, and opportunities; - Build and maintain dashboards and reports using data visualization tools; - Use AI copilots to accelerate data exploration, query generation, and insight discovery; - Work within cloud data warehouse environments such as Snowflake; - Troubleshoot and resolve data quality and integrity issues; - Conduct ad-hoc analysis using tools such as Excel or Google Sheets; - Present insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. MUST HAVES - 4+ years of experience as a Data Analyst; - Advanced proficiency in SQL , including complex queries, joins, and data transformations; - Hands-on experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses; - Strong experience with Excel or Google Sheets , including pivot tables and data analysis; - Experience with data visualization tools such as Tableau , Power BI , or Data Studio ; - Proven ability to identify and resolve data quality and integrity issues; - Experience using AI-powered tools to support data analysis workflows; - Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills; - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present insights clearly to stakeholders; - Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field; - Upper-intermediate English level. NICE TO HAVES - Experience working in cross-functional or business-facing analytics roles; - Familiarity with data governance or data quality frameworks; - Basic experience with Python for data analysis. PERKS AND BENEFITS - Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps. - Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets. - Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies. - Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

Title: Engineering & Quality - Software Engineer
Description: Fitch Group is currently seeking a Data Engineer based out of our Monterrey, Mexico office. As a leading, global financial information services provider, Fitch Group delivers vital credit and risk insights, robust data, and dynamic tools to champion more efficient, transparent financial markets. With over 100 years of experience and colleagues in over 30 countries, Fitch Group’s culture of credibility, independence, and transparency is embedded throughout its structure, which includes Fitch Ratings, one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, and Fitch Solutions, a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst. Fitch's Technology & Data Team is a dynamic department where innovation meets impact. Our team includes the Chief Data Office, Chief Software Office, Chief Technology Office, Emerging Technology, Shared Technology Services, Technology, Risk and the Executive Program Management Office (EPMO). Driven by our investment in cutting-edge technologies like AI and cloud solutions, we’re home to a diverse range of roles and backgrounds united by a shared passion for leveraging modern technology to drive projects that matter to our organization and clients. We are also proud to be recognized by Built In as a “Best Place to Work in Technology” 3 years in a row. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, we offer an exciting and supportive environment where you can grow, innovate, and make a difference. Want to learn more about a career in technology and data at Fitch? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Technology-and-Data/ How You’ll Make An Impact Hands-On Lead and mentor a high-performing data engineering team, fostering technical excellence and professional growth while ensuring delivery of scalable, modern data solutions aligned with business priorities. Partner with the CDO team and data product leaders to define and execute the vision for a AWS-based data platform that enables enterprise-wide self-service, unlocking data for AI, analytics, and innovation. Drive architectural decisions and establish best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and distribution frameworks that accelerate time-to-insight for data producers and consumers. Champion adoption of emerging technologies such as Agentic AI and Generative AI, integrating advanced capabilities into data workflows to enhance user experience and position the organization as “AI-Ready.” Ensure operational excellence and reliability by proactively addressing complex data engineering challenges, implementing robust quality controls, and preventing production incidents. You May Be a Good Fit If 4 to 5 years’ experience ‘hands-on’ leading highly technical data-centric software engineers, preferably in financial services, in support of Data Lake houses (e.g. AWS, Databricks, Snowflake), data virtualizations solutions (e.g. Starburst), modern data catalogs & data quality capabilities (e.g. Collibra), and Master Data Management (e.g. Informatica) Proven AWS expertise (S3, EKS, Lambda, Glue, EMR, Redshift, S3, RDS/Aurora, Valkey/Redis, Step Functions, MSK/Kafka, Event Bridge). AWS Certification strongly preferred Experience applying AI/ML to boost engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q). Strong Python for data engineering (Pandas, Spark/PySpark) and API Development (FastAPI or similar). Design and build high-performance REST/GraphQL APIs with optimized query patterns, pagination, caching, and schema design to ensure low-latency, performant reads at scale. Build ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and streaming; Kafka/MSK with schemas (Avro/JSON) and delivery semantics. Optimize performance of object-based and relational datastores Design applications with microservices and containerization mindset with ‘decoupling’ architectural principles Caching with Valkey/Redis: TTL strategies, invalidation, key design. CI/CD and IaC with GitHub, Git/GitHub workflows, ArgoCD. Security and reliability: IAM, KMS, secrets, VPC networking, observability (OpenTelemetry), SLOs, cost governance. Ability to solve complex data-driven requirements and triage towards defects and production bugs Technology solutions and tools including data governance and catalog solutions (e.g. Collibra, Alation, data platform and lake(house) (i.e. ‘medallion’ architecture), and data mesh and virtualization tools (e.g. Starburst, Denodo) . Experience in leading evaluation of new technologies and methodologies to enhance efficiency. (“Buy” vs “Build”) What Would Make You Stand Out Hands-on experience building AI agents (e.g., using LangGraph or LlamaIndex), implementing RAG over enterprise data, and enforcing robust guardrails through rigorous testing and evaluation, including Agentic AI connection protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) Applying AI/ML to boost engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q) and using agentic AI to automate workflows such as code reviews, test generation, data quality checks, and runbook execution. Knowledge on SSO implementation and Azure AD (MS Entra) groups Great communication and collaboration skills Proven ability to drive innovation and install a culture of ‘continuous improvement’ that measurably improve business outcomes Ability to communicate effectively & translate technical concepts to with senior management & non-technical stakeholders. Why Choose Fitch Work-Life Balance First: 40% in-office monthly stay connected while keeping flexibility. A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work. We evaluatequalified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

Title: PRACTICANTE ANALÍTICA AVANZADA
Description: #BrillaEnAlEn como Practicante de Analítica Avanzada ¿Te apasiona el análisis de datos, el desarrollo de modelos analíticos y transformar información compleja en insights que impactan decisiones estratégicas? En este rol formarás parte del CoE de Datos y Analítica, colaborando en el desarrollo de modelos avanzados que evalúan y mejoran el forecasting organizacional, contribuyendo directamente a la planeación de la demanda. En Grupo AlEn llevamos más de 75 años transformando hogares y comunidades con soluciones de limpieza innovadoras y marcas icónicas. Somos una empresa orgullosamente mexicana con presencia en México, Estados Unidos, Centroamérica y el Caribe, y nuestros productos están presentes en el 97% de los hogares mexicanos. Nuestro propósito es construir un mundo más limpio y sostenible para ti. ✨ ¿Qué harás en este rol? Recibir y analizar requerimientos del negocio, comprendiendo los procesos de planeación y forecasting. Desarrollar y evaluar modelos analíticos para medición de la asertividad del forecast organizacional. Trabajar con herramientas del model garden de Google y flujos de datos estructurados. Generar insights, dashboards y recomendaciones accionables, y presentar resultados ante el CoE de Datos. 🎯 ¿Qué buscamos? Graduación en Junio 2027 o años posteriores. Estudios comprobables. Disponibilidad para cumplir 6 horas diarias (Lunes a Viernes) durante un año. Cumplir la mayoría de edad. Carreras afines a: Ciencia de Datos, Analítica, Sistemas, Tecnologías de la Información o Software. Ingeniería Industrial, Logística, Manufactura o Producción. Administración, Finanzas, Economía o Negocios. Habilidades técnicas: Manejo de bases de datos. Comprensión de flujos de datos. Herramientas de visualización: Power BI (preferente) y deseable Looker. Habilidades blandas: Pensamiento analítico y crítico. Comunicación clara de resultados técnicos. Organización y seguimiento de proyectos. Trabajo en equipo y orientación a resultados. 👉 ¿Qué puedes esperar al unirte a Grupo AlEn? Bienestar integral: compensación competitiva y prestaciones superiores a la ley. Desarrollo que impulsa: aprendizaje práctico en proyectos reales de analítica avanzada y data-driven decision making. Entorno colaborativo, abierto y ágil, donde la innovación y los datos generan impacto. Propósito que inspira: construimos todos los días un mundo más limpio para ti. 🚀 ¿List@ para tu siguiente reto? ¡Postúlate ahora y ven a #BrillaEnAlEn! En Grupo AlEn promovemos una cultura de inclusión y equidad. Todos nuestros procesos de selección son gratuitos y están abiertos a cualquier persona, sin distinción de edad, origen étnico, religión, género, identidad u orientación sexual, estado civil, condición física o de salud, ideología política o cualquier otra característica personal.

Title: Platform Operations Engineer
Description: Job Description GM Financial is set to change the auto finance industry and is leading the path with embarking on tech modernization – we have a startup mindset, preserve our small company culture, in a public company environment with financial stability and intense growth over a decade long history. We are data junkies and trust in data and insights to advance our business objectives. We take our goal of zero emission, zero collision, zero congestion and zero friction very seriously. We believe as the auto finance market leader we are in the driver’s seat to lead us in the GM EV mission to change the world. We are building global platforms, LATAM, Europe, China – our high performing talent needs a high performing leader. GMF is comprised of over 10,000 team members globally. Join our fin-tech culture within a Blue-Chip company where we are changing the way we use technology to support our customers and business. The Platform Engineer in the Loan Originations domain is accountable for building, operating, and evolving the Loan Origination platform. This includes enabling secure, scalable, and resilient platform for applications across LATAM markets, with a focus on automation, observability, high-availability, and compliance. Responsibilities Collaborate with product and business teams to design, build, and operate platform capabilities that accelerate delivery of customer value with high quality, velocity, and safety. Develop and maintain standardized tooling for deploying and running the Salesforce Platform, ensuring alignment with enterprise best practices and Cybersecurity compliance requirements. Continuously evolve the Salesforce platform to adopt modern technologies that improve performance, resiliency, high availability, and cost efficiency. Architect and implement self-service capabilities for the Salesforce team by automating provisioning, deployment pipelines, and observability workflows to reduce operational overhead and eliminate manual touchpoints. Participate in cross-functional initiatives to raise engineering standards and align platform strategy with broader Salesforce release goals. Partner with other Platform, Test and Software Development Engineer’s to establish and best-practices that enable efficient and effective delivery of outcomes for our customers. Build automation for platform operations, infrastructure provisioning, and environment management using tools like Gearset and Azure DevOps. Implement automated controls and compliance checks into the platform to support cybersecurity and audit readiness (e.g., Splunk SIEM integration, SSL enforcement). Participate in on-call rotations to ensure rapid resolution of platform-related incidents, especially during Salesforce and application release windows. Optimize platform FinOps by monitoring usage, cost drivers, and scaling strategies. Ensure robust observability and performance monitoring using Nebula, Azure App Insights, and Splunk. Qualifications Strong experience across the SDLC: system design, scripting, testing, CI/CD, observability, and security. Excellent communication skills (verbal and written), with a customer-focused mindset. Proven ability to drive continuous improvement and adopt a growth mindset. Experience building platforms that support scalable, resilient servicing applications. Deep knowledge of Salesforce platform, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud. Proficient in scripting/programming languages: Apex, JavaScript, HTML, CSS. Hands-on experience with DevOps and SRE tooling: Gearset, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Nebula Logger, Splunk, Azure App Insights. Familiarity with Chaos Engineering principles and practices. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and practices. Experience in Agile environments with a track record of driving improvements. Expert in performing Root Cause Analysis and Problem Management 7 or more years in IT/engeneering , including 4 or more years in Platform, Cloud or DevOps roles, with strong expertise in Salesforce and reliability engineering. Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related Engineering field; and/or commensurate experience preferred. Verbal and written proficiency in English, Portuguese and/ or Spanish. Preferred Certifications: Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder GM Financial is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Title: OpenText Info Archive Developer
Description: We are seeking a skilled and motivated OpenText InfoArchive Developer with 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in designing, developing, and testing applications within the OpenText InfoArchive environment. In this role, you will play a key part in optimizing enterprise data archiving solutions, ensuring smooth data access, compliance, and operational efficiency. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and test applications using the OpenText InfoArchive platform. Write and optimize SQL queries within SQL Server Management Studio to support data archiving and retrieval. Integrate InfoArchive solutions with enterprise data environments to ensure seamless functionality. Implement effective data migration and archiving strategies to meet business and compliance requirements. Collaborate with business analysts and architects to define and deliver technical solutions aligned with organizational goals. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues promptly to minimize downtime. Document technical designs, application changes, and processes thoroughly for future reference. Skills & Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. 2–5 years of relevant experience working with OpenText InfoArchive. Title: ERP Data Analyst
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls is a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. With operations in over 150 countries, we are committed to driving innovation and excellence in building technologies and integrated solutions. Our people are at the heart of our success, and we are passionate about attracting and developing top talent across the globe. We are looking for an Enterprise Data Specialist. What will you do? In this role, you will play a critical role driving the success of our digital transformation initiatives by supporting data migration projects from legacy ERP systems to SAP S4 HANA / ECC and Oracle Fusion, as well as conducting data audits to ensure the accuracy and quality of existing data from prior implementations. The Data Analyst will be responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting large datasets to provide actionable insights that support business decisions. This role involves working closely with cross-functional teams to identify trends, optimize processes, and ensure data accuracy and integrity. In This Role, You Will Data Migration: Collaborate with teams to migrate large datasets from legacy ERP systems to SAP S/4HANA / ECC and Oracle Fusion, ensuring data accuracy and completeness. Conduct data audits to verify the accuracy and quality of existing data from previous implementations. Utilize Microsoft Excel and Power BI for data analysis and reporting. Automate or optimize data workflows using Python or SQL (a strong plus). Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify gaps, document process improvements, and enhance decision-making capabilities through reliable data. Demonstrated knowledge of Supply Chain Item Master data, Item Creation. How will you do it? Data Migration. Coordinate and execute the migration of large datasets from legacy ERP systems to SAP S/4HANA / ECC and Oracle Fusion, ensuring data integrity throughout the process. Ensure data quality, consistency, and completeness throughout the migration process. Data Auditing. Conduct comprehensive audits of existing data to identify discrepancies, errors, and outdated information. Validate and correct data to ensure alignment with business requirements and adherence to data governance standards. Data Analysis & Reporting. Analyze complex datasets to identify patterns, trends, and correlations. Use Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other analytical tools to create dashboards, trend charts, and presentations. Deliver actionable insights to stakeholders by identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations to communicate insights effectively. Collaboration & Issue Resolution. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into data-driven solutions. Organize and lead meetings with IT specialists, PTF process owners, and functional leads to address and resolve data-related issues. Document findings, assign responsibilities, and monitor due dates to ensure timely resolution of outstanding items. Tool & Process Improvement. Utilize statistical methods and tools to improve decision-making processes. When applicable, leverage Python or SQL to handle big data challenges, automate workflows, and optimize data processes. Identify opportunities to enhance ERP data structures, governance strategies, and reporting capabilities. Knowledge Transfer & Change Management. Document key learnings to support training content for end users. Collaborate with the change management team to ensure proper communication and adoption of new data processes. What are we looking for? Bachelor’s degree in data science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Actuarial Science or a related field (or equivalent work experience). Proficiency in English (both written and spoken) is required to effectively communicate with global technical and non-technical audiences. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP, macros, etc.) and solid experience with Power BI (data modeling, dashboards, DAX). Experience working on ERP implementation or migration projects at scale. Practical experience with ETL processes and familiarity with data governance frameworks is preferred Strong analytical skills with a prove ability to manage and interpret large datasets effectively. Familiarity with Python or SQL for data transformation and automation is highly advantageous. Experience or exposure to SAP S4 HANA, ECC, Oracle Fusion, or other major ERP systems—particularly in the Supply Chain Environment significant plus. Possess a problem-solving mindset with the ability to troubleshoot data-related issues in a demanding environment. What do we offer? Comprehensive benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth and development. Supportive and inclusive work environment. Commitment to work-life balance and employee well-being. Engagement in meaningful projects that make a difference.
